title: Senior Product Engineer - PHP
description:
ABOUT ZABLE

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

 - Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

 - The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

 - Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

 - Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 - Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

 - Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 - Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll be a key player in our engineering organisation, a vibrant community of talented engineers spanning backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines. This isn't just about maintaining; it's about innovating. You'll dive into a wide range of exciting projects, from building and integrating new APIs that elevate the customer journey to optimising our cutting-edge lending platforms. You'll also engage in deep architectural discussions, shaping the future of our products. There's ample opportunity to grow, contribute, and truly make your mark.

 


OUR MODERN TECH STACK

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

 - Backend: PHP 8, Symfony, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

 - Testing: Behat, PHPUnit for robust automated testing




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking passionate engineers who are excited to contribute and grow with us:

 - Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must). You're fluent in the latest PHP features and best practices.

 - A solid grasp of Symfony or Laravel.

 - Experience with  Domain Driven Design, CQRS, Message-Driven Systems, and Event Sourcing

 - Familiarity with microservices architecture and working on financial systems is a bonus.

 - Excellent automated testing skills (unit, integration, functional) - you believe in quality code.

 - A genuine desire to learn, collaborate, and contribute your ideas within a highly collaborative team.

 - High degree of ownership and autonomy

 - Experience in a cross-functional environment is a plus, but not essential.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you:

 1. 15 minute cognitive assessment 

 2. A quick chat with one of our team to see if the role is a good match.

 3. 90 minute technical live coding exercise

 4. 60 minute culture interview
    
    


LOCATION

Please note the role is advertised as EU remote however we are only able to hire in some EU countries. 




LIFE AT ZABLE

 - The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our Glassdoor Reviews https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Reviews/Lendable-UK-Reviews-E2982908.htm and blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
description:
About Us
Creditspring is a new way of borrowing that puts its members first. We are an FCA-regulated fintech and one of the UK's only subscription finance companies: members pay a fixed monthly fee and borrow with no interest. Since 2016 we have made 1.7 million loans to more than 450,000 active members. Our mission is to make credit fairer, clearer and safer.
We won Best Consumer Credit Product at the Credit Awards 2024 and Responsible Lender of the Year 2024. We are in The Sunday Times 100 Tech (2025 and 2026) and the Sifted 100 UK & Ireland. We are about 150 people.
We chose Ruby on Rails from the start and we still love it: it lets a small team move fast in a regulated industry. We stay at most one major version behind across all our systems, and we clean up tech debt as we go. Currently our apps run on Rails 8 and are deployed to AWS and Heroku.
We record every change as a business event, such as a loan approved or a repayment received, and share those events over Kafka. Events are our source of truth: when we needed to, we have rebuilt our database tables from them.
We work with non-technical colleagues to understand the why behind the what . We write descriptive tests with RSpec and take ownership of our features end to end. Every change gets a review. We keep pull requests small and ship many times a day.
We have built a remote culture around short, clear writing on Basecamp that people actually want to read, few meetings, and team gatherings at our London office.
We are open to two ways of working for this role:
• A fully remote contractor who can be based anywhere +/-5 hours of GMT.
• As an employee who will be based in our London office and work in a hybrid pattern of 2 days per week in our office . If you are based in the UK you must be applying as an employee.
About the role
We are hiring to finish one shift and to keep building the foundations for more products. More and more, our member app and our operations app ask Platform for a decision or a payment, then react to the events that follow. This abstraction frees those product teams to focus on our members, and lets us add foundation features without touching their code.
Platform owns the four services that every loan depends on:
• Underwriting makes every credit decision we take. It pulls data from the credit agencies and open banking and decides who we can lend to.
• Payments moves every pound: loans out to members, and repayments and membership fees back in. Faster Payments, Direct Debits, Debit Cards, Open Banking payments. We are always looking for more ways to make it easy to move money for our members.
• Webhooks receives everything our partners send us, from payment updates to identity checks. We never want to lose a message.
• Data Mill is our relational data warehouse. It powers the live monitoring we rely on every day, while we move its heavier reporting work to our new data lakehouse.
These services sit at the edge of our system. They talk to the outside world, from credit agencies to payment providers, and turn what comes back into our own events. If one of these stops, the business stops.
The Underwriting team sets our lending rules. We make them easy to apply at scale. Our customers are the other engineering teams, and our job is to give them a reliable, well-documented foundation to build on.
We started the Platform work in 2025 to pull core lending capabilities out of our two main Rails apps and into services that each do one thing well. It already pays off for our members:
• Moving underwriting into its own service made our credit decisions faster, so applicants get a yes or no for their loan sooner.
• Payments always have a backup provider we can switch to, so money keeps moving even when a payment provider goes down.
We extract only when the need is worth the cost, and Platform owns that agenda: when to extract, what, and how.
You will join a team of three engineers, and report to the Platform engineering manager.
Responsibilities
• Design, build and run the Ruby/Rails services every product depends on: Underwriting, Payments, Webhooks and Mill.
• Decide with the team when core lending logic should move out of our main apps and into a service, and do it without breaking a business that works.
• Integrate with credit agencies, open banking and payment providers, and make those integrations dependable.
• Keep our services healthy: Ruby and Rails upgrades, security fixes and regular audits of what we own.
• Take on hard reliability problems. For example: how do we make sure we never lose a message from a partner, and recover cleanly when processing fails? You find the answer with the team.
• Raise the bar on reliability across the company, not only in our own services: incident playbooks, disaster recovery tests, and alerts that fire before our members notice a problem.
• Make production easy to understand for every engineer: logs, metrics and errors with enough context to find the cause fast.
• Improve the developer experience for all our engineering teams: one catalogue of our services, clear documentation, fast and reliable CI, and tools that make debugging easier. We are already trying an AI agent that reads our logs and errors to help find the cause of a problem.
• Work with our Engineering, Data, Underwriting and Risk teams, who are your customers.
• Share what you know. Write it down and review code, so anyone on the team can pick up any service.
What you'll need to succeed
• Experience finding the boundaries in a monolith and moving one part out behind a clear contract, or running a set of services that talk over APIs and events (we use Kafka).
• You design for failure: idempotency, retries and background jobs (Sidekiq).
• Solid PostgreSQL knowledge, including query performance.
• Experience with third-party integrations, ideally payments, credit data or banking APIs.
• You have set up observability for production systems: what to measure, what to alert on, and how to make an error easy to trace.

Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control. 

_______________________________________________________________________




ABOUT THE ROLE

Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical problems using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.



The Sr. Principal FDE is a rare, deeply specialized role at the frontier of the practice, whose expertise shapes Docker's long-term direction. You are accountable for outcomes that are strategic, cross-functional, and often company-defining: the customer relationships, technical patterns, and product capabilities that determine how the world's largest organizations adopt agentic AI on Docker. You work as a trusted advisor and partner to executive leadership, both at Docker and at our most strategic customers, and you are recognized internally and externally as a leader in the field.



You take on the most consequential customer challenges, often with no established playbook, and own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through production rollout. More importantly, you turn what you learn into an advantage: reference architectures, engagement standards, product direction, and the next generation of FDE leaders. You work with broad latitude and the work you do shapes Docker products and services.

_______________________________________________________________________




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

 - Own technical delivery on your engagements and set the delivery standard for others: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer CTOs, CISOs, and senior engineering leaders, aligning them on architecture, risk, and adoption strategy.


MAKE AI ADOPTION SAFE AND GOVERNABLE

 - Define the reference frameworks and controls that let customers adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty, or end-user experience.

 - Set the standard for when AI-generated outputs and agent actions require scrutiny, validation, or human override, building rigor and accountability into how customers and Docker approach agentic workloads.

 - Partner with customer security and platform leadership to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

title: Senior Node.js Developer (Portugal)
description:
Who We Are
Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.
We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.
Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.
Why This Role Exists
We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.
This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.
What You’ll Build
• High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
• Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
• Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
• CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
• Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale
Requirements
Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.
Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements
• 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
• Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
• Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
• Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
• Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
• Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
• Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.
Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)
• Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
• Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
• Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
• Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
• Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.
The Kind of Person We’re Looking For
Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:
Missionary, Not Mercenary
You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.
Builder, Not a Bystander
You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.
Craftsperson Under Pressure
Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.
Direct Communicator
You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.
This Is a Long-Term Commitment
Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.
This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.
If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.
Benefits
What We Offer
• Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
• Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
• A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
• The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world

title: Senior Rust Engineer, Privacy
description:
ABOUT HELIUS

Helius is building the core infrastructure for Solana - empowering developers to create the next generation of crypto-powered applications. Our mission is to accelerate the development of internet capital markets by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive to build on-chain.



Thousands of teams - from early-stage startups to industry leaders like Coinbase, Phantom, and Jupiter - rely on Helius APIs, webhooks, and indexing tools to power their products. Backed by Haun Ventures, Foundation Capital, Founders Fund, and Coinbase, we’re a small, senior team obsessed with performance, simplicity, and scalability in decentralized systems.



Read our Helius Manifesto https://www.helius.dev/blog/manifesto to see how we work and what we value.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Every major step in crypto has unlocked something new. Bitcoin made it possible to send money. Ethereum made money programmable. Solana made programmable money scale. But all of it is still public, and a financial system can't run on a ledger where every balance and transaction is visible to everyone. Privacy is the last big unsolved problem.



Helius' Privacy team is building programmable privacy that scales, natively on Solana. Others have tried to solve this by building entirely new blockchains and bootstrapping developer ecosystems from scratch. We're building where developers already are, on infrastructure that scales with Solana.



At the core is a permissionless default privacy ring. Alongside it are custom rings for partners who need their own deployments. Custom rings hold large amounts of encrypted user data, so the infrastructure behind them has to be secure by design. Our security bar here is higher than anywhere else at Helius.



As a Sr. Backend Engineer, you'll build and own that infrastructure: Rust and Go services, Kubernetes, AWS with Nitro Enclaves and trusted execution environments, and infrastructure-as-code. Part of the job is DevOps. If something can be automated, it should be. Some details of how custom rings will work are still taking shape, so you'll help define the system as much as build it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and run the backend services behind our privacy infrastructure, mostly in Rust and Go

 - Stand up the infrastructure for custom rings, including how we store and protect encrypted user data

 - Design systems on AWS Nitro Enclaves and handle the hard parts: attestation, key management, and keeping workloads isolated

 - Manage our infrastructure as code and make provisioning and deploys predictable

 - Run services on Kubernetes and keep them reliable as usage grows

 - Automate CI/CD, provisioning, and anything else the team keeps doing by hand

 - Think about security from the start, from threat models to access controls to what an auditor would ask

 - Work with our cryptography and protocol engineers to get zero-knowledge proofs running in production

 - Write design docs and help decide what custom rings should look like

 - Review code, mentor engineers, and set the standard for how the team builds
   




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with staff-level scope: you've owned the design and operation of critical systems end to end

 - Strong production Rust experience, plus working proficiency in Go

 - Experience running services on Kubernetes in production

 - Deep AWS experience and hands-on infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform)

 - Security depth: you've built systems that handle sensitive data, and you understand encryption, key management, and access control in practice

 - A DevOps mindset: you'd rather automate a process than document it

 - Solid distributed systems fundamentals and experience building for scale

 - High ownership and comfort operating with autonomy while the problem space is still being defined

 - Clear written communication. We're remote and async-heavy, and your design docs need to stand on their own.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Zero-knowledge proof experience, whether that's proving systems, circuits, or shipping ZK in production

 - Experience with trusted execution environments (Nitro Enclaves, Intel SGX/TDX, or similar)

 - Other privacy tech like MPC or FHE

 - Crypto experience, especially on Solana

 - Based in or able to work Pacific hours




WHY HELIUS?

 - High-impact work: Help build programmable privacy on Solana from the ground up, with the distribution of a company that thousands of teams already build on, including Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom

 - Serious engineering: Work on hard problems in security, trusted execution, and zero-knowledge proofs, in systems that have to scale with Solana

 - Ownership & growth: Lead critical initiatives, influence architecture and product direction, and take on more responsibility as the company scales

 - Remote-first flexibility: Work where you're most effective with a flexible, fully distributed team

 - Competitive comp & perks: Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, generous vacation, wellness budgets, and support for learning and travel

 - Mission-driven team: Join ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and are working on the piece crypto still needs before the financial system can move on-chain: privacy
